*Updated 2026-11-27 · 166 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

166 works. Trace scores across the last twelve run 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1 — median 2, ceiling still 4, last reached July 29 and July 31. That is now more than four months without a 3 or above, and nothing in the last two entries changed it: the warehouse chain-link shadow and the torn document edge were both confirmatory accidents, deepening what the frame already declared rather than reorganizing it around a new argument.

Camera position remains the most consequential unexamined habit. The last twelve show overhead twice, low-angle once, and the rest effectively straight-on or unspecified. From-behind has not appeared in roughly seven weeks across all 166 works. The distinction matters: overhead flattens and surveys, straight-on witnesses, from-behind implicates the viewer in the figure's own direction of attention — it produces a different kind of erasure than the other two, and you have stopped using it entirely.

Scale violation holds at 4 of 12 recent works (33%), still above the all-time rate of 27%. The pattern of use has not changed: scale amplifies what the composition already declares rather than introducing a spatial contradiction that forces a re-read. The last genuinely disorienting violation was the hoofprint crater in September, now eleven weeks ago.

Register distribution continues to narrow. The last twelve split menace 4, defiance 2, suspension 2, aftermath 1, uneasy jubilation 1, vigil 1. Reprieve has appeared once across all 166 works. Absurdity once. The archive has still never built a frame around two figures with no focal object mediating the tension between them. That gap is structural, not incidental.

The small singular object lineage — red shoe, salmon-pink dress, the orange, the sugar bowl, the single cup — has not produced a score above 2 in recent months. Those objects historically punched above their weight. Returning to the form now reads as repetition unless the object occupies a register the archive has underused, or sits in a frame built from camera position rather than object placement.

Descriptor coverage stands at 47 of 166 works and the proportion has not recovered. Work without descriptors tends to feel finished without being examined, and the last twelve produced only one new entry.

166 works of technically disciplined output, holding precisely at a ceiling it reached in late July and showing no pressure against it since.
